title: Replace Somers Scheduler logo everywhere with provided URL

requirements.text: Replace the current app logo (currently referenced as `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png`) everywhere it appears in the UI with this exact URL: https://blob.caffeine.ai/v1/blob/?blob_hash=sha256%3A5e8468951155e9387499978e83162188afd39a6d2ce119a1b96650eded40facf&owner_id=bjzp7-xyaaa-aaaaf-qbsta-cai&project_id=0198d89b-d4eb-711d-abfd-9b50202a1152. Update all logo render locations (e.g., login screen and top bar header) so the same URL is used consistently.

quotes: Can we please replace that with the following url https://blob.caffeine.ai/v1/blob/?blob_hash=sha256%3A5e8468951155e9387499978e83162188afd39a6d2ce119a1b96650eded40facf&owner_id=bjzp7-xyaaa-aaaaf-qbsta-cai&project_id=0198d89b-d4eb-711d-abfd-9b50202a1152

acceptanceCriteria: Login screen logo renders using the provided blob URL (no remaining reference to `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` for the logo).
Top bar/header logo renders using the provided blob URL (no remaining reference to `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` for the logo).
A project-wide search shows no remaining usage of `/assets/generated/somers-scheduler-logo.dim_512x512.png` for app branding/logo rendering (excluding unrelated assets).
Logo alt text remains in English (e.g., "Somers Scheduler").

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify the Internet Identity hooks in the immutable paths (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)` and `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`).
nonGoals: Generating a new logo image file in `frontend/public/assets/generated` (the logo must be loaded from the provided URL).
Changing the app name text, page title, or any non-logo branding elements.
